 Matt Brooks ● @MattBrooksNBA Writer & Digital Content Specialist November 20, 2026 11:29 AM MST The Denver Nuggets look to improve to 2-0 in the Emirates NBA Cup Group Stage.
 INJURY REPORT 
 Denver:
DaRon Holmes II — OUT (G League Assignment)
Bryce Hopkins — OUT (G League Assignment) 
Julian Strawther — OUT (Left Knee Sprain)
Cam Whitmore — OUT (G League Two-Way Assignment)
 Houston:
Steven Adams — QUESTIONABLE (Right Quadriceps Contusion)
Clint Capela — OUT (Right Ankle Sprain)
Quadir Copeland — OUT (G League Two-Way Assignment)
Julian Phillips — OUT (G League Two-Way Assignment)
Alperen Şengün — QUESTIONABLE (Left Eye Corneal Abrasion)
Bruce Thornton — OUT (G League Two-Way Assignment)
 The Nuggets face the Houston Rockets for the second time this month.
 They fell to the Rockets, 110-100, back on November 9th. Rebounding played a big role in the result, as Denver lost on the glass, 51-39. That's been a theme for Denver early in the season; they rank just 22nd in this statistic league-wide, with 42.0 boards per game.
 However, the Nuggets are coming off a 105-101 win over Boston, where they tied the Celtics on the glass, 46-46. This was very easily Denver's best win of the season, mounting a 17-point comeback at home.
 One thing of note is Ryan Nemhard, a two-way player for the Nuggets, was recalled from Grand Rapids for Friday's game. Bryce Hopkins, another Nuggets two-way player, was sent to the Gold in return.
 Friday's game is also an Emirates NBA Cup game. They're 1-0 in the Group Stage of the tournament after defeating the Phoenix Suns, 127-120, in late October. Only the Dallas Mavericks are ahead of them at 2-0 in Western Conference Group C. Denver can advance to the Knockout Stage of the tournament with Group C's best record. They could also progress as one of the two Western Conference wild cards.
 TUNE-IN : Friday, November 20, 8:00 p.m. MT; Prime Video; Altitude Sports Radio 92.5 FM
